steps.title: Forward speed
steps.say: The robot's speed is the **average** of the two sides.

steps.title: Turning speed
steps.say: When the sides go different speeds, the robot turns. Divide the difference by how far apart the wheels are.

steps.title: Open Robot.java
steps.say: Press **Ctrl+P**, type `Robot` and press Enter. Quick Open finds any file by name, so you never have to dig through folders.

steps.title: Find STEP 2
steps.say: Right under STEP 1. Press **Ctrl+F**, type `STEP 2` and press Enter to jump to it.

steps.title: STEP 2
steps.say: Fill in the three TODO lines under this comment.

steps.title: Start the robot
steps.say: Your code only runs once it's built and started.

waitFor.hint: press Start and wait for Running.

steps.title: Enable in Teleop
steps.say: Pick **Teleop** and press **Enable**. Robot code runs only while it's enabled.

steps.title: Check it
steps.say: Drive forward: linear speed goes up. In AdvantageScope, search for `LinearSpeed`, then drag **Robot/LinearSpeed** onto the **Left Axis**.

steps.title: And turning
steps.say: Now spin in place: angular speed jumps, linear speed stays near zero. In AdvantageScope, search for `AngularSpeed`, then drag **Robot/AngularSpeed** onto the **Right Axis**.
